summary: A small legend sprite in the top-left corner defines a pattern that maps to existing colored blocks in the grid; missing pixels from the legend are then placed at corresponding scaled positions.
src: pixels in top-left legend sprite s that are not yet represented in the main grid
dst: scaled grid positions d corresponding to legend pixel positions
match_cond: s.legend_position maps to d.grid_position via scale factor derived from existing colored blocks alignment
symbol_instructions: top-left pixel pattern serves as minimap legend defining full pattern to be placed at scaled positions in grid
multi_step: Step 1: identify top-left legend sprite (small colored pattern); Step 2: locate existing colored blocks in main grid that match some legend pixels; Step 3: compute scale factor and offset from legend to grid; Step 4: for each legend pixel not yet in grid, place scaled block at computed position
